# Hashed install for .github/workflows/govinfo-lsa-2023-title33.yml.
# This file is valid only for Python 3.12. It is not a Python 3.10 lock.
# Resolved on Python 3.12.3 from PyPI for pypdf==7.1.1 (2026-11-21).
# python3 -m pip download pypdf==7.1.1
# python3 -m pip download pypdf==7.1.1 --no-binary=:all:
# python3 -m pip hash on the saved wheel and sdist.
# That download selected no other distribution. pypdf 7.1.1 declares
# typing_extensions>=4.0 only when python_version < "3.11". Those hashes
# are absent. Installing this file with --require-hashes on Python 3.10
# does not supply that dependency. The only consumer sets python-version
# to 3.12 and refuses any other minor version before pip runs.
--require-hashes
pypdf==7.1.1 \
    --hash=sha256:04c5680d4b4cfa04ab505b09393fc949860c34a4dad6565284d11a2f5c3ce8b1 \
    --hash=sha256:2eff4e2fc5fb22a6d6711e6f1166cdc9ab5765d90cd0d77dfea3f4aa91a27b1d
